headline: Sensex and Nifty surge as FII buying and lower crude oil prices drive a massive market recovery

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Massive rally in Indian indices driven by strong foreign fund inflows
Lower crude oil prices providing a boost to the domestic market sentiment
Positive global cues with Asian markets advancing after a late US stock rebound
Strong performance in FMCG and private banking sectors leading the market gains
whatHappening: Sensex surged over 2,000 points and Nifty topped 25,900 in the previous session
Indian markets rallied 1.8%, recouping almost all losses sustained during 2026
Government announced Rs 2,814 crore support for lithium and nickel processing plants
Brent crude oil prices rose toward $94 following reports of Saudi oil attacks
summary: Indian markets experienced a significant rally, with the Sensex jumping over 2,000 points and Nifty reclaiming the 25,900 level. The surge was supported by robust foreign fund inflows, lower oil prices, and gains in FMCG and private banks. Global markets also showed strength, while the government announced support for the lithium and nickel sectors.
